newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine bonds cautious ahead of U.S data.
newsitem.headline: Argentine bonds cautious ahead of U.S data.

text.p: Argentine bonds were trading slightly lower late morning Monday in a thin market whose eyes are set on key U.S. economic data to be released this week, traders said.

"The Employment Cost Index that will come out of the United States on Tuesday will give local traders strong cues," said one trader at an Argentine bank. "It will help determine interest rates movements there."
"We are currently trading very cautiously. We do not believe tomorrow's figures will help this market," the trader added.
Argentina's Par Brady bond was down 1/4 at 62-3/4 while the dollar-denominated Bocon Previsional 2 was unchanged at 126 in slim volume.
Another trader agreed the market was thin due to the wait-and-see attitude prevaling among local traders as they awaited U.S figures. "Tomorrow is key," he said.
